limits: Transverse NOTE y is dynamic; X/Z and orientation are fixed ideal constraints with zero velocity/work, not a free 6DOF body.
Only positive-side cassette exists in this fixture; negative-side geometry is not queried or adopted.
Fixed cradle; reaction forces/moments are reported but there is no moving-base dynamics.
Pressure is recomputed every RK4 stage and endpoint using the area law, never spring force as prescribed NOTE normal.
One-sided normal-only coupling: mu=0 and fixed belt rotors. No feed, floor, gravity, acquisition, or score simulation.
Initialized with stored spring/contact energy as a declared isolated fixture, not an actual ground-acquisition handoff.
Holding_input applies no-NOTE nominal mechanical equilibrium torque, not an ideal cam-angle constraint or guarantee of equilibrium with NOTE.
Mass/inertia, pressure stiffness, cam compliance/damping and mechanical torque are explicit unmeasured hypotheses; no servo electrical or thermal model.
Grid/phase controls and RK4 residual retained; finite samples and small time refinement are not a full spatial/time convergence certificate.
Resting stop reaction can balance force with zero work; moving hard-stop impact remains UNKNOWN and rejects atomically.
